architecture_summary: PageIndex MCP is a FastMCP + arq + MinIO + Redis + Postgres tree-reasoning RAG ingestion platform (10,948 graph nodes / 18,883 edges indexed; 1,271 functions, 549 classes, 535 files). The audited pipeline runs: converter chain (pipeline.py/indexer.py, local Docling-CPU + remote Scaleway Docling + AGPL pymupdf4llm fallback) -> normalize.py (NFKC, bidi) -> helpers/garble.py detect_garble kernel (13 callers, 9+ subsystems) -> helpers/gates.py evaluate_gates -> helpers/verdict.py apply_promotions/compute_verdict/classify_verdict -> dual persistence writers (storage/documents.py save_doc with _confirm_write_visible barrier; storage/verdict.py save_doc_meta without barrier) -> worker/registry_mirror.py Postgres CAS registry + registry_backfill/reconcile.py drift reconciliation -> storage/documents.py erasure cascade (_ERASURE_MANIFEST, 11 steps). picture_plane.py and converters/pictures.py handle per-picture OCR decisioning (decide_ocr_strategy/decide_ocr_mode) parallel to page-level OCR escalation in client/indexer.py and client/recovery.py. Eight defect zones span this whole chain; four of them (Verdict-Gate, Garble Kernel, OCR Recovery, Converter/AGPL) are chronic repeat-regression sites spanning 20+ chains/RFCs (022,024,025,026,033,040) across the audit history, each narrowing scope only to have a new bypass path reopen it. This wave (POST-FIX-WAVE3) split Dual-Writer Verdict Persistence out of the Erasure zone, and the corpus audit tooling itself was confirmed to share the pipeline's own block.get('text','') table-blindspot bug (self-reinforcing measurement-blindspot cycle).
past_constraints: CLAUDE.md Hard Rules directly implicated: HR5 (never silently persist low-quality tree) is violated by the verdict hysteresis band reclassifying zero-content FAIL as MARGINAL; HR4 (AGPL awareness) is violated by structural converter failures silently walking the chain to AGPL pymupdf4llm with only a log warning; HR2 (erasure must cascade across every derived store) is at risk from the asymmetric save_doc vs save_doc_meta consistency-barrier split. mem-search confirms: Docling-CPU is the config-gated converter (pymupdf4llm drops ligatures, RFC-003 Amendment 4); AGPL has three pullers (pymupdf4llm + docling-hierarchical-pdf + pageindex fork itself); a fabricated-corpus-report incident (2026-07-17) already established that audit numbers must be verified against MinIO meta.json, reinforcing this wave's Zone 8 finding that the audit tooling shares the pipeline's own measurement blind spot. Per user feedback constraints: skip PASS docs and focus on regressions (all four top-scored zones here are explicit wave-over-wave regressions); prefer simple fixes; verify source before asserting any [FIX] claim.
